scope: Two-turn, one-model Responses conversation with one sealed staged function tool, shared local token and declared-cost ledger, process deadline, and local tool cap

verification.independent_review: No open P1/P2 in the reviewed diff; 127 focused tests, Ruff, compileall, and diff check passed

negative_controls: Lossy function or CLI JSON decimals reject before provider count or staged claim
Unsupported response output rejects before launching a tool
Forged completed state without two observed turns rejects
Second-turn request missing prior response rejects even if its builder is faulty
Default scheduled effort cannot be changed to high in the plan
Started run with a pending model reservation reports indeterminate and retains the budget
Tool output failure and model or tool caps stop before the next provider send
limits: Provider transport was fake or local HTTP; no real model, bill, or provider version was authenticated
The one-process deadline and declared price ceiling do not enforce a global study spending cap
Tool arguments travel in child argv and may be visible through local process inspection
The staged journal and schedule are under same-UID local control, not independent custody
No N/S/T matrix, blind judging, reserved case, food intervention, or field outcome was evaluated
